### x-ray-sampling-is-parent-based

**Claim.** X-Ray sampling is parent-based: the sampling decision is made once, typically by the first X-Ray-enabled service that handles the request, and a downstream service honors a decision that already exists regardless of its own sampling rules.

> — [Configuring sampling rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)

> "If a downstream service receives a request that already has a sampling decision from an upstream parent, it will honor that decision regardless of any of its own matching sampling rules."
> — [Configuring sampling rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)

**Checked.** 2026-10-15.

> "To avoid incurring service charges when you are getting started, the default sampling rate is conservative. You can configure X-Ray to modify the default sampling rule and configure additional rules that apply sampling based on properties of the service or request."

**Claim.** By default the X-Ray SDK records the first request each second and five percent of any additional requests: one request per second is the reservoir, which ensures that at least one trace is recorded each second while the service is serving requests, and five percent is the rate at which additional requests beyond the reservoir size are sampled.

**Scope.** default sampling rule of the X-Ray SDK; default; not adjustable.

> "By default, the SDK records the first request each second, and five percent of any additional requests. One request per second is the *reservoir*. This ensures that at least one trace is recorded each second as long as the service is serving requests. Five percent is the *rate* at which additional requests beyond the reservoir size are sampled."

**Checked.** 2026-10-15.

### x-ray-sampling-rules-in-console-avoid-redeploy

**Claim.** If the X-Ray SDK reads sampling rules from a local JSON document, each instance performs sampling independently, which increases the overall percentage of requests sampled, and you must redeploy your code to update the rules; rules configured in the X-Ray service can be managed without additional deployments.

**Write it as.** `each instance performs sampling independently` · `manage rules without making additional deployments`

**Scope.** per sampling rule.

> "You can configure the X-Ray SDK to read sampling rules from a JSON document that you include with your code. However, when you run multiple instances of your service, each instance performs sampling independently. This causes the overall percentage of requests sampled to increase because the reservoirs of all of the instances are effectively added together. Additionally, to update local sampling rules, you must redeploy your code."
> — [Configuring sampling rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-console-sampling.html)

> "Because the rules are configured in the service, you can manage rules without making additional deployments."
